name: order_lookup
description: Look up orders for a customer by customer_id. Optionally filter by product_id to get a specific order.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to look up orders for (e.g. C-01)

product_id.description: Optional product ID to filter a specific order (e.g. P-001)

name: user_lookup
description: Look up customer information by customer_id. Returns the customer name and country code.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to look up (e.g. C-01)

name: product_lookup
description: Look up product information by product_id. Returns product name, category, and provider.

product_id.description: The product ID to look up (e.g. P-001)
